consequence.statement: The Traefik Gateway API controller requires the ReferenceGrants RBAC permission to function; if not granted, the controller cannot access ReferenceGrant resources.

original.statement: ReferenceGrants RBAC permission is added to the Gateway API Traefik controller in version 3.0.0.

consequence.statement: Documentation-only change: the Gateway API RBAC example in the reference docs now lists ReferenceGrants. The release evidence does not say that any shipped component, permission or behaviour changes when the operator does nothing.

corrected.statement: Traefik 3.0.0 updates the Gateway API RBAC reference documentation (kubernetes-gateway-rbac.yml) to include ReferenceGrants. This is a documentation-only change with no stated operational consequence.

decision.reason: The changelog files this item under Documentation [ev-b93f05e6d823]. The linked PR says it adds ReferenceGrants to the RBAC example "in the dynamic reference documentation" so the documentation is up to date [ev-1f07b2650f2e]. It changes only docs/content/reference/dynamic-configuration/kubernetes-gateway-rbac.yml [ev-d28c42488d88]. No shipped manifest or controller behaviour changes, and no evidence says access is lost or anything fails, so permission-lost overstates the consequence: it should be none (informational).
